title: Contextualizing Biological Language Models across Modalities via Logit-Space Contrastive Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2606.18703v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pretrained biological language models encode rich probabilistic structure through native token distributions, but multimodal adaptation typically aligns hidden representations or replaces the native likelihood interface with task-specific heads. We introduce LOGICA (Logit-space Contrastive Alignment), whose central methodological change is to align the context-conditioned native token distributions themselves rather than pooled latent representations. Using native-head-preserving cross-modal adapters, LOGICA couples models with distinct vocabularies and tokenization schemes without requiring a shared tokenizer, decoder, or embedding space. Contrastive learning operates directly through each model's original token-likelihood interface, enabling mutation-local ranking, cross-modal dependency mapping, and context-guided sequence design without task-specific heads. translated_title: 通过Logit空间对比对齐实现跨模态生物语言模型的语境化

tldr: LOGICA的核心创新是在logit空间中直接对齐上下文条件下的原生词元分布而非潜在表示，通过保留原生输出头的跨模态适配器，无需共享分词器或任务特定头即可实现跨模态生物语言模型的耦合，支持突变排序、跨模态依赖映射和序列设计等任务。
